Subject: Short-window group demo: proposed rapid rebook and host rotation

Hi all —

Thanks for the quick interest in a joint 30–45 minute walkthrough of Redwood Inference. We have a tight window next week and want to make sure everyone can join a single short session rather than separate demos. Proposed slots (PST):

- Tue Dec 1, 11:00–11:45am
- Wed Dec 2, 9:00–9:45am
- Thu Dec 3, 4:00–4:45pm

Quick ask: reply with your preferred slot + any hard constraints. We can rotate hosts and keep the agenda laser-focused: 1) 10-minute tailored use-case highlights, 2) 20-minute demo pointing at cost/latency tradeoffs, 3) 10–15 minute Q&A + next steps.

Attachments: one-pager (high-level agenda) attached for context.

If none of the three work, tell us two small windows and we’ll attempt a rapid rebook.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
